agyos_skill.instructions: The **control / director's** generative-video producer — the edit-grade counterpart to **veo-3** (all-round + native audio), **kling** (native 4K/multi-shot/motion), and **luma** (cinematic HDR/mood) under the **ai-video** router. It briefs controlled, consistent shots; Runway renders; a human assembles them (adding audio via ai-voiceover); WoopSocial schedules/publishes. Reach for Runway when you need **control** — a specific camera move, a **consistent character across shots** (Gen-4 References), or to **edit/restyle existing footage** (Aleph) rather than generate from a blank prompt. If you just want a clean cinematic clip **with native audio** in one pass, that's **veo-3**; native 4K/multi-shot/motion-transfer is **kling**; HDR mood pieces are **luma**. Runway wins on control, consistency, edit-grade video-to-video, and pipeline fit — ads, product, client deliverables, previz (4K here is an upscale, not native). 1. **brand-profile** — look, audience, non-negotiables. 2. **voice-builder** — so the shot and any narration fit the brand. (Depth: `references/the-shot-framework.md`.) - **S — Set the shot:** directorial brief (subject, camera move, motion, lighting/mood, aspect ratio). - **H — Hold consistency with References:** Gen-4 References to lock a character/object/style across shots. - **O — Operate the controls:** Camera Control, Motion Brush, **Aleph** (edit existing footage), **Act-Two** (consented performance). Model: Gen-4.5 (hero) / Gen-4 Turbo (test). - **T — Trim & assemble:** clips are short (2–10s per generation), **no native audio** → stitch in the edit, add voice via **ai-voiceover**, captions via **captions-and-clipping**. Gen-4.5 (flagship text/image-to-video), Gen-4 Turbo (fast/cheap iteration), Aleph 2.0 (video-to-video editing), Act-Two (performance capture), References (consistency), Motion Brush, Camera Control, 4K upscaling. Clips 2–10s per generation; bills **credits per second per model** — test cheap/short, then commit to hero runs. Now a multi-model marketplace (Veo/Kling/Seedance in one sub). Full detail: `references/runway-2026-capabilities.md`; pick vs siblings + recipes: `references/control-recipes.md`.
